name: starfiniti-loyalty
description: Open-source, self-hosted multi-tenant loyalty platform for WooCommerce.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run ci:validate && npm run deployment:validate && npm run pilot:validate && npm run experience:canary:validate && npm run analytics:canary:validate && npm run entitlements:validate && npm run architecture:validate && npm run accessibility:validate && npm run woocommerce:validate && npm run build
scripts.deployment:validate: node scripts/deployment-preflight.mjs --self-test && node scripts/bootstrap-initial-tenant.mjs --self-test && node scripts/validate-backup-assets.mjs
scripts.woocommerce:validate: node scripts/validate-woocommerce.mjs && node scripts/validate-woocommerce-localization.mjs && node scripts/validate-woocommerce-storefront.mjs && node scripts/validate-woocommerce-blocks.mjs
scripts.woocommerce:runtime:test: wp-env run cli --config .wp-env.woocommerce.json wp plugin activate starfiniti-loyalty && wp-env run cli --config .wp-env.woocommerce.json wp option update woocommerce_custom_orders_table_enabled yes && wp-env run cli --config .wp-env.woocommerce.json wp option update starfiniti_runtime_expected_hpos yes && wp-env run cli --config .wp-env.woocommerce.json wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/starfiniti-loyalty/tests/runtime-smoke.php
scripts.db:concurrency: node scripts/verify-ledger-concurrency.mjs && node scripts/verify-reward-capacity-concurrency.mjs && node scripts/verify-referral-reward-concurrency.mjs && node scripts/verify-audience-snapshot-concurrency.mjs && node scripts/verify-campaign-capacity-concurrency.mjs && node scripts/verify-analytics-export-concurrency.mjs && node scripts/verify-programme-group-sharing-concurrency.mjs
scripts.db:verify: node scripts/require-container-runtime.mjs && npm run db:start && npm run db:reset && npm run db:test && npm run db:concurrency
